label: Hindi

label: Bahasa Indonesia
population_definition: People aged five or older reported able to speak Indonesian under BPS's conversational definition; this is a reach ceiling, not a count needing every curriculum bundle.

label: Russian — Russian Federation
population_definition: Rosstat count of people reporting ability in Russian; separate from daily use and not a literacy, L1 or academic-proficiency count.

label: Punjabi (Pakistan standard)

label: Javanese
population_definition: Home language among population age 5+ in Census 2010.

label: Central Thai
population_definition: 2010 census population classified as using only Thai at home (59,866,190) or Thai and another language at home (4,214,001); the two published categories sum to 64,080,191.
